I'll keep this tight, because it's the busiest stretch of our year and I don't have time to go back and forth.

We're Nettlerow, a small software company in Cork. We build stock software for independent pharmacies. It tracks expiry dates shelf by shelf and drafts wholesaler orders before anything runs out. Every August the back-to-school rush clears out head-lice treatments, children's paracetamol and plasters, and every year pharmacists tell us they got caught short. That's the story for this campaign.

What I need: as many booked demos as possible. That's the only number I'm judging this on. Not likes, not followers. Demos in the calendar.

Dates: the campaign starts Friday, 6 August 2027 and ends Thursday, 19 August 2027, Irish time (Dublin). Fourteen days, start to finish.

Send people to https://nettlerow.ie/demo. Here's the copy from our landing page, word for word:

"Nettlerow is stock software for independent pharmacies: it tracks every expiry date on your shelves and drafts your wholesaler orders before you run short. Plans start at €89 a month per branch in Ireland and £79 in the United Kingdom, and pharmacies that book a demo by 19 August get their first 60 days free. Available to pharmacies in Ireland and the United Kingdom only."

We serve Ireland and the UK and nowhere else, so a demo from anywhere else is wasted. One thing to be clear on: we don't have X's pixel on the site, so X won't see the demos being booked. I count them on our end.

You can launch and run this yourself. You don't need my sign-off on anything. I mean that, so please don't send me questions you can answer yourself. Keep an eye on it every day of the campaign and fix what isn't working. When it's over, send me a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks. Short, as in I can read it between two calls.

Total budget: 350.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 3 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
